note: Independent re-audit against RFC 7854 Section 4.2 ('It is 4 bytes long if an IPv4 address is carried in this field (with the 12 most significant bytes zero-filled) and 16 bytes long if an IPv6 address is carried in this field.') at HEAD. parseIPInto (bmp_events.go) clears out[:12] and writes IPv4 into out[12:16], or writes full 16-byte IPv6 via As16(); writePeerHeader copies Address verbatim. Positive TestParseIPIntoIPv4 asserts all 12 leading bytes are zero and bytes 12..15 equal 192.168.1.1. Negative TestParseIPIntoIPv6 compares all 16 octets of 2001:db8::1 exactly against the full IPv6 representation rather than 12-byte zero padding.
